per_chapter.01_the_bump: 11 sheets, 88 pictures. No concrete defect. The recipe value 25.2 at x = 1.1 (degree 40) and the bump value 0.452 are right; (1 + 1.21^21)/2.21 = 25.23 and 1/2.21 = 0.4525. per_chapter.04_reading_color: 12 sheets, 94 pictures. Concrete defects: D1 and D2 (known Lows) only. The colour readings are right: z^2 cycles twice (+2.0), 1/z gives -1, and 1/(1+z^2) has poles at +-i, each -1 turn. The gold segment is shown. The question card "where are the bump's poles? how many turns at each?" sits over an empty plane at 83-96 s, an intended prediction hold.
per_chapter.05_gallery: 17 sheets, 129 pictures. Concrete defect: D3 (known Low); observation O1. Values checked: z^3 - 1 has three zeros and "turns: 3 = zeros inside". (z-1)/(z+1)^2 has a simple zero at 1, a pole of order 2 and turns -2. e^z has no zeros or poles; 2pi = 6.28. sin(i) = 1.18i and sin(3i) = 10.0i. tan(0.4 +- 12i) = +-1.0000i. Gamma(4) = 6, Gamma(5) = 24, poles appear at 0 to -4, "no zeros anywhere". zeta: the series converges for Re s > 1 (left side dimmed), a single pole at 1, trivial zeros at -2, -4, -6. The strip zeros 1/2 + 14.13i, 21.02i, 25.01i and 30.42i match 14.1347, 21.0220, 25.0109 and 30.4249. "Riemann hypothesis: open" and the "precisely" card (four zeros by Newton's method) are clear of the strip. The strip is faint at 7320, inside the C10 window that root already viewed.
per_chapter.07_one_point: 12 sheets, 92 pictures. Concrete defect: D4 (known pacing Low). z^2 doubles the 90 deg angle at 0 to 180 deg, and a cross away from 0 keeps 90 deg. The ratio |h|^2/h = conj(h) goes to 0 along the right, up and spiral approaches; a real step gives a positive ratio and an upward step a downward one, as conj requires. At 1, a step right gives 2 and a step up gives 0 (f(1+it) - f(1) = t^2, so the ratio is -it). In the |z|^2 x jagged g panel the inside radius shrinks 0.55 -> 0.06 and the ratio scatter stays inside its circle (checked only at sheet resolution). U, its three disks and the holomorphic definition card are clear. No lower card overlaps a plate.
per_chapter.10_rigidity: 11 sheets, 85 pictures. No new concrete defect. The disk chain stays in U (cleared at 960x540). sin^2 + cos^2 = 1 holds on the real line and so on the whole plane: sin^2(3i) is about -100.36 and cos^2(3i) about 101.36 (exactly -100.357 and 101.357), with sum 1.000000. e^(-1/x) has every derivative 0 at 0, recipe 0. The zeros of sin(1/z) are at 0.318, 0.159, 0.106 -> 0, with "0 is not in the region". For sin z, Liouville is stated right; |sin z| = 1.68 at about 1.3i (sinh 1.29 = 1.68) and sin(3i) is about 10.0i. The "names to search: Liouville's theorem" card clears the plate bottom.
